title: Design System: RivyaLivingArt Phase 3 homepage and shared public frame

scope.status: Phase 3 local implementation following Phase 1/2 approval; independent finish disposition ship; Phase 4 and release gated
scope.authority: Homepage renderers and shared public header, navigation, search entry, mobile menu and footer only
scope.method: Source extraction and validation of existing receipt counts; no browser rerun in this documentation pass
scope.excluded: Other website page bodies, Studio, publication, data mutation, GitHub push/PR and release
preservedDrift: PRODUCT.md still says Phase 2 only, pending Phase 3 approval and disconnected routes.
Phase 2 DESIGN.md and sidecar retain their historical local foundation boundary.
Phase 1 documentation retains historical approval-pending wording.

motion.name: dialog-entry
motion.purpose: Public frame native dialog, no reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: category-caption

motionCapability.query: (min-width: 900px) and (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)
motionCapability.cleanup: Revert GSAP context; cancel requestAnimationFrame refresh; restore prior inline document scrollBehavior; data-home-motion returns static; dispose timeout/query listener on unmount.
motionCapability.failure: Dynamic import failure leaves server-rendered static content readable.
motionCapability.scope: Selected/story heading categories; standard composition has two moments, fallback may match several selected headings. Shared incumbent CSS effects remain separate.
motionCapability.excluded: No ScrollSmoother, pinning, transformed page wrapper or Studio motion integration.

extensions.breakpointPolicy: Layout queries use max-width unless the name states minimum or desktop-menu-close. Root header-height and scoped actual frame heights are distinct; see DESIGN.md.

media.images: Cover imagery; preserve stored associations and inline positions. Logo and film use contain. Editorial crops switch at 780px.
media.film: Native controls, muted loop, playsInline, preload=none, no autoplay; deliberate input; near-frame poster loading at 800px; pause offscreen/hidden; original still and unavailable message on failure; print-only still retained.
media.categoryFallback: Existing first-letter monogram; no invented image association.
media.provenance: Six Phase 2 candidate images remain proposals with null Studio IDs; visualization or fixture assets do not establish customer or completed-project evidence.

receipts.scope: Local route browser emulation; no record writes.
Four synthetic fixture variants and all 18 conditional slots; no database writes.
Local browser, locale cookie and saved-piece localStorage only.

evidence.captures: Opening, selected gallery, material, collections, closing, footer, menu and fixture work/words/workshops/journal captures are listed in the existing receipts.

mobileFull.method: Settled viewport tiles; sticky header once; no layout/content modifications

evidence.finishReview: Parent-supplied independent finish disposition ship across five review sections; no material local Phase 3 fixes.
evidence.limits: No new browser run by documenter; no native/device/screen-reader/language/human or production certification. Synthetic fixtures do not prove optional source content is published.

extensions.snippets: Static source-derived specimens. Root CSS variables have literal fallbacks for standalone rendering. No React, external assets, app mutations or fonts are embedded. Sample labels do not replace source copy.

narrative.overview:
Resin imagery leads within obsidian and ocean framing, with warm ivory reading intervals and restrained champagne details. Large serif headings, asymmetrical photographic groups and generous chapter spacing give existing content a deliberate reading rhythm. This language carries forward the owner-approved Phase 1 and Phase 2 direction; it does not introduce a new visual-world choice.

Phase 3 brings that direction into the real homepage renderers and shared public header, navigation, search entry, mobile menu and footer. This document governs that local implementation only. Other website page bodies and Studio remain incumbent or future-phase work; Phase 4 and release remain gated. Original logo assets, main colours, published text, saved conditions, media associations, focal positions and functionality constrain the visual treatment.
keyCharacteristics: Original identity, source content and stored presentation choices remain intact.
Dark photographic chapters alternate with quiet ivory reading and closing surfaces.
Category images keep stable targets; asymmetry comes from composition, not hover expansion.
Content is server rendered and visible before optional motion loads.
Film playback requires deliberate input; navigation and dialogs retain native behavior.
Local integration and browser evidence remain separate from native, human and release acceptance.

rules.name: The Original Identity Rule
rules.body: Preserve original logo bytes and main colour values; keep the logo contained on ivory without filters or recolouring.

rules.name: The Visible Content Rule
rules.body: Text remains readable before JavaScript and throughout motion; enhancement never gates access to content or controls.

dos: **Do** keep this authority limited to the Phase 3 homepage and shared public frame, with further phases and release gated.
**Do** preserve original identity, content, stored conditions, selected media, crops, routes and manual sending boundaries.
**Do** keep image frames filled while retaining logo and film containment and existing focal positions.
**Do** keep text visible, native scrolling intact, film playback deliberate and dialog focus recoverable.
**Do** distinguish local browser receipts, synthetic fixtures, independent finish review, owner acceptance and native/device/human evidence.
donts: **Don't** promote this scoped extraction into root design authority or redesign other page bodies or Studio from it.
**Don't** activate optional offerings, relabel fictional feedback, assign proposed media to records or infer customer evidence from visualizations.
**Don't** add hidden text reveals, expanding category columns, scroll hijacking or autoplay.
**Don't** equate the local ship disposition or unavailable detector with production, physical-device, screen-reader or language acceptance.
**Don't** repair historical Phase 1/2 or PRODUCT.md status wording as part of this documentation-only extraction.
